name: Multi-Lyrics
description: Multi-Lyrics queries lyric sources in a user-configurable priority queue, records whether each result is synced, plain or instrumental, serves the lyrics for the track being played through GET /Audio/{id}/Lyrics, keeps a per-source retry cache, exposes an admin-only manual search/status API, and can optionally call a companion Demucs+WhisperX service to align plain lyrics into word-level timings. Lyrics are ephemeral: fetched on demand and held in memory only, never written to the library or metadata folder. Genius scraping is OFF by default and requires an explicit Terms-of-Service acknowledgement.
overview: Fetch lyrics from multiple sources in a configurable priority order (LRCLIB, lyrics.ovh, Tekstowo, Genius)
